data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open the form, optionally tick Book with miles, enter origin and destination from suggestions, set dates, click Find flights, then pick a fare) with the right parameters, but it adds extra detail (adults and children split, optional result-page edits) and leaves the order of some steps slightly off.
